tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i grwa lnga'i sgrub dkyil dbang chog la dogs gcod the tshom rnam sel bzhugs so// thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang po'i gzungs grwa lnga'i sgrub dkyil dbang chog bcas la dogs dpyod yi ger/ thog mar mchod pa byin rlabs las/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sarka ra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ thog mthar sbyar ba'i prokṣa ṇaṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes gsungs pas/ oṃ āḥprokṣa ṇaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes gsung rgyu yin 'dug de nas/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas shapta āḥhūm̐ bar la/ de nyid gsum gras āḥhūm̐ rjes la gsungs pas gong du oṃ āḥmi dgos/ mjug tu swā hā med pa tsam khyad par/ tshogs zhing mchod pa la ni de nyid gsum ma spel ba'i dbang du mdzad pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi dha ri maṇḍal sa pa ri wā ra hrīḥpra wā ra sarka ra pā dyaṃ prokṣa ṇaṃ arghaṃ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dya/ shapta hūm̐ zhes gsung rgyu yin 'dug bdag bskyed skabs dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bdag nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma zhes sogs zer dgos sam/ sor 'brang gi g.yas kyi phyag mtshan gcig ma tshang ba ral gri lhor gsang sngags rjes 'dzin ma ser mo sku mdog nag mo min nam snyam pas/ lhor gsang sngags rjes 'dzin ma sku mdog nag mo yin nam/ sor 'brang bsil tshal rma bya chen mo rnams la/ bcom ldan 'das ma yong ba ltar na/ shar du bcom ldan 'das ma stong chen mo sogs/ bcom ldan 'das gsang sngags rjes 'dzin la zhes dgos sam snyam/ shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu ma zhes dgos sam snyam yang / rdo rje zer ba chad/ bdag bskyed bsdu skabs su khams gsum snod bcud bsdu ba dpe phal cher la/ dang po rang nas chad yod 'dra yang dgos sam snyam/ sa lha'i mchod pa byin rlabs skyabs 'gro'i mgo bzhin la/

dharma ra ṇi dang rol chen med/ shapta āḥhūm̐ yin yang āḥchad/ sa lha'i mchod par mtshan sngags re re sngon 'gro'i mchod sngags la de nyin gsum spel ba mchod pa byin rlabs bzhin/ sa lha'i gtor ma byin rlabs dang 'bul sngags kyang dpe phal cher la chad pas/ de ni 'di yin te/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur ces dang / g.yas mchog sbyin dang oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī oṃ a kā ro mu sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ lha sta gon srung 'khor spro sngags la phyag rgya dang / brtan sngags la phyag rgya med/ lha bskyed chog ni gtso mo nas byang sgo ma'i bar dgos/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren gyi mchod pa tshogs zhing skabs ltar/ dbang lha spyan 'dren mchod sngags ma dag pas/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra gcig sngon 'gro'i tshogs zhing mchod sngags ltar/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma'i zhabs bsil la/ ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol gyi rjes su/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi dha ri maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra hrīḥpra wā ra sarka pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ya swā hā/ de bzhin du rab 'byams sogs/ zhabs bsil sogs/ oṃ nas sa pa ri wā ra prokṣa ṇaṃ pra tītstsha ya swā hā/ rab 'byams sogs/ mchod yon sogs/ oṃ nas sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ya swā hā/ me tog nas/ rol mo'i bar rigs 'gre/ gos zung byin brlabs dang / srab 'jam sogs spyi 'gre/ mtshan sngags mthar gos sngags/ gtor ma cha gsum la/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ oṃ a kā ro man 'dra/ 'on kyang bgegs gtor 'dor dus/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri sogs kyi rjes su gsung rgyun las 'byung ba'i bgegs thams cad nye bar zhi ba sogs brjod pa'am ma brjod kyang rung / snyan gsan 'bebs tshig grangs ji ltar nus pa/ nyer mchod lnga zhes byung yang / ji ltar nus pa nyer mchod pa min nam/

bum bskyed rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa zhes sogs byung ba ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar gnas pa'i sogs gong gzhal yas khang gi gdan bskyed dang 'dra/ bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma lha bcu gsum dang las bum du sor 'brang gcig pu/ rgyas gdab pa grub nas mchod bstod med par gzungs thag bzung nas sngags bzla/ bzlas pa grub nas/ hūm̐ bdun bzlas pa'i me tog bum par gtor/ dbang bshad na lung dang lung don ma 'byor ba 'dra mo'i sangs rgyas tshul 'dug kyang / theg chen lugs la thog mar 'og min du sangs rgyas nas/ slar 'dzam gling du rgyas tshul yin snyam/ sde snod gsum gyi rjes su kur rtags byung ba ni/ nyi khri (khram)chig stong zer ba rnams rtags su bsdus/ thob bya'i 'bras bu'i gong du spang rtogs la khyad par yod par bshad pa dang 'gal rgyu'am go ma bde bas gsung 'dir chad skyon med dam/ drug pa rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i slad du zhes pa las ma byung yang / 'og tu bdun pa de ltar byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa la zhes 'byung ba ltar na rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i slad du zhes sbyor dgos sam/ srung skud la bsangs sbyangs zhes byung bas srung skud la las bum gyi chu gtor te bsangs sbyangs/ don tshan bcu gsum pa'i 'grel par/ dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du byas na/ sngags kyi spyod pa zhes sogs byung bas dam tshig dang sdom pa srung sdom tshul bzhin du byas nas zhes dgos sam/ sta gon rjes chog las/ gnas gsum bsrung rjes bkra shis gsung yang / bsngo smon byar rung bas/ 'di ltar bsgrubs pa'i sogs nas/ 'dir phyi'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig bar tshe chog bzhin/

dngos gzhi'i skabs/ cha gsum dkyil 'khor mthar ma bsgrigs par 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa rdzogs pa dang / stegs kyi khar phyogs skyong 'byung bgegs gtor ma rnams rang la kha bltas nas bsgrigs mdun chu gnyis nyer mchod lnga bshams la chus sbyangs/ gang zhig mtshan mo tshugs pa dang / /mchod pa zhal zas nas mchod yon bar/ bgegs gtor la blugs/ snod rnams kha bub/ rdor dril gsor dkrol dang / las sngags kyis bgegs skrod pa'i tshe phyogs skyong 'byung gtor phyi der bzhag bgegs gtor mchod bcas rgyang ring dor/ las sngags bzla zhing nang du 'ong / sgo nang du bslebs pa dang nye reg bya/ oṃ badzra be ga sogs brjod nas dkyil 'khor drung du song la bskor ba sogs yin/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang gsungs pas/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs tshigs bcad lhug gi nongs bshags don la thob/ glu dang me tog 'bul sngags kyi gsham na/ zhes gsungs shing / rang gi mgo la bcing zhes byung yang min nam snyam ste/ 'bul sngags zhes sbyar na rang la rang gis zhe sa byas par song zhing / lhag par mgo la bcings sngags min pa'i phyir/ len sngags mthar rdor dril bcas phyag gsum 'bul skabs bcom ldan 'das ma sogs brjod/ dbang bshad na de la rgyud sde gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga dang / drug tu yod pa las zhes byung yang / drug tu 'dod pa sogs yod pa las zhes dgos sam snyam/ so sor 'brang ma gtsor gyur pa'i gzungs grwa lnga lha bcu gsum zhes dgos sam/ zhugs nas dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga la gnyis las zhes byung yang / cho ga gnyis las zhes gsung rgyu yin/ chas 'jug la oṃ zhes pa'i rkyen gyis gsung ba byung yang / oṃ zhes pa'i brjod pa'i rkyen gyis yin nam/ smad g.yogs byin rlabs la oṃ ma ṇi dha ris bsngags pas zhes pa ltar na sngags des smad g.yogs la sngags brjod byas par song zhing / sngags pas gsung na byin rlabs byas par song /

dbang gi nang 'jug phyag 'tshal la/ dkyil 'khor gyi nub kyi 'od dpag med dang / byang gi don yod grub pa zhes byung yang sngon ma rnams 'dra bar dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams las 'od dpag med ces sogs dang / don grub ces sogs thob snyam/ phyag 'tshal skabs bla ma dang dkyil 'khor rje btsun ma la zhes byung yang / bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo rje btsun ma la yin nam/ ye shes 'bebs skabs dril gsil khong 'di khyod sogs shlau ka gcig tshar gcig dang / oṃ nas/ āḥgasum bar yang yang brjod/ lha ngo bstan rjes phyag 'tshal tshig kyai rdor sogs nas 'byung ba dang 'dra/ dbang stegs steng bskyed gtso mo rkyang pa yin/ 'di'i zhabs bsil sngags la phaṭa lhag rdo rje can sogs gsol 'debs tshar gcig phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis sogs khang rjes su zhes pa'i tshigs bcad gsum brjod pa gsum pos zhes byung yang / zhes pa'i tshigs bcad gsum brjod pa sngon 'gro'i yin nam/ chu dbang gi sngags oṃ ma hā sogs tshar gcig dbang bskur rdo rje sogs sngags bcas kyis slob ma du yod la dbang bskur/ dbu rgyan dbang la ral pa'i nas a bhi ṣiñtsa mi bar tshar gcig de nas slob ma re re bzhin la oṃ badzra dha tis spyi bo/ oṃ sarba dpral ba/ oṃ ratnas rna ltag g.yas/ oṃ dharmas ltag pa/ oṃ karmas rna ltag g.yon du reg la bkon/ dril bu'i dbang la rdor dril bsnol dus nang thams cad ces pa las ma byung yang / lus kyi nang thams cad yin nam/ oṃ badzra gaṇḍe sogs dang bcom ldan sogs tshar gcig mda' gzhu'i rjes gnang la/ de rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang zhes byung yang / khyed rnams kyi yin nam thabs kyi mda' drug shes rab kyi gzhu la bkang ste gsung yang / shes rab kyi mda' drug thabs kyi zer ba'ang gzhan du 'byung bas gang dag dung byin te chos 'di'i sgra sgrogs shig pa'i don yin gsung ba byung yang chos kyi sgra sgrog shig zer ram snyam ste/

de rjes po ti byin nas chos 'di'i sgra sgrogs zer dgos pas so/ /rin chen sna bdun rjes gnang ni ma 'ongs nas a bhi ṣiñtsa mi bar slob ma du yod la bya/ des gzungs grwa lnga nas gsungs pa'i slob dpon a bha yā ka ri'i zhal snga nas bkral ba'i zhes sogs byung yang / gzungs grwa lnga nas gsungs pa'i don slob dpon sogs dgos sam/ zhes sa skya pa kun blos 'di'i nyams len pa rnams la phan phyir dogs gcod du bkod pa dge/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang gi grwa lnga'i sgrub dkyil dbang chog la dogs gcod PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
